bind_address.description: Local IP address for pptpd to bind to (server interface). Leave at default (127.0.0.1) for localhost-only; set to public IP for remote access.

device.description: Explicit PPP device name (e.g., ppp0). If empty, devices auto-allocated from ppp0 upward.

timeout.description: Control connection timeout in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout.

mppe.description: MPPE encryption policy. 'required' or 'required-128' recommended for security.

ms_chap_v2.description: Enable MS-CHAPv2 authentication. Required for MPPE. Disable only for legacy client compatibility.

ip_ranges.description: IP address pools: local is the server IP (as seen by clients), remote is the client IP range(s).

remote.description: Remote (client-side) IP address range (e.g., 10.0.0.10-10.0.0.100, or single IP).

dns_servers.description: DNS servers to push to VPN clients (IPv4). Use internal servers for enterprise networks.

wins_servers.description: WINS servers to push to VPN clients (for NetBIOS name resolution). Typically empty for modern networks.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to syslog.

logwtmp.description: Enable logging of user logins/logouts to /var/log/wtmp.

rate_limit.description: Max PPTP connections per source IP per second (0 = unlimited). Use to mitigate brute-force or DoS.
